title: The Path to Karsus
summary: Supplies the door sequence to open the Karsus Vault.

fields.Puzzle: In the Sorcerous Vault, take Silverhand, then Abjuration, then Silver. Pull the lever to unlock the Karsus Vault, then return to the entrance. Knock can open the vault directly.
fields.Acquisition: On a rosewood desk at X −11, Y −95.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
